comment: The capture matrix, in ONE place. .github/workflows/capture.yml reads this
to build its job matrix and scripts/common/check-coverage reads it to say
which cells have a profile, so the plan and the report cannot disagree.
A matrix written into the workflow and a coverage report written from
somewhere else is a value in two places with no check that they agree.
enabled false is a cell that is PLANNED and not attempted. It is reported
as such rather than dropped, because a coverage report that lists only what
was tried cannot show what is missing. TODO/corpus.md, CORPUS-02.
required true means check-coverage --require-rows can be asked to fail on
it. Nothing is required by default: the flag names what a caller cares
os is the runner label and it is the only field the workflow needs that the
corpus does not have. browser, channel and platform are the three keys a
profile's route is derived from, spelled exactly as the corpus spells them.

cells.why: The cheapest lane there is: the runner image ships Chrome, so this needs no acquisition at all.
The one platform the corpus already has, captured again on a runner rather than on a laptop. Two profiles of one build on two platforms is what decides whether the TLS half is platform-independent.

The same engine with a different brand list and User-Agent, so it isolates branding from engine at almost no cost. Enabled 2026-09-02: the driver resolved Edge 151.0.4129.101 at /usr/bin/microsoft-edge on the ubuntu-latest image in capture.yml run 33579619515, and b-ids-driver drive takes a --browser switch now, so the lane drives the family this row names.

A third platform and a second architecture. Waiting on DRIVER-05 having a route that serves a macOS build, and on the identity writer taking its platform from the run rather than from a two-way branch.
How the project gets ahead of a release rather than behind it. Waiting on acquisition: no runner image ships a beta channel.
A genuinely different TLS stack and the highest-value non-Chrome lane. Waiting on the resolver knowing the family at all.
